text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo crosses the finish line in 
first place. Burning through everything 
she had, she pulls off a miraculous 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Witnessing that run, Tokai Teio decided 
not to retire. She had been reminded of 
what it means to never give up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having accomplished what she needed to, 
Twin Turbo sleeps, utterly exhausted. 
Choosing her next race isn't even an 
option right now...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What if Tokai Teio could make a comeback? 
Alone, the Trainer set their sights on the 
Arima Kinen.
